class.name: LRTVolume
class.brief_description: Local Radiance Transfer volume for the fixed static N1 fixtures.
class.description: Owns one local volume: shared geometry SDFs, per-instance albedo/emission fields, the analytic comparison path, the direct-light source term and the 26-neighbor RGB SH4 transport with global visibility. Geometry fields are process-wide shared by content, precision and algorithm version; material edits therefore do not duplicate or rebuild distance data. Fields stay on the GPU and are exposed as textures for diagnostic display and as CPU copies for parity checks.

method.name: clear_shared_sdf_cache
method.description: Drops process-wide references to shared geometry SDFs. Existing volumes keep their active references. Intended for deterministic cache tests and diagnostics.

method.name: build_local_field
method.description: Builds the local field from the configured boxes and uploads it to the GPU. [param backend] is [code]sdf[/code] (prototype default, per-box Color SDF) or [code]analytic[/code] (analytic box query). Returns probe, receiver and mismatch counts.

method.name: configure
method.description: Uses the prototype's fixed grid region for the given probe spacing.

method.name: configure_with_bounds
method.description: Uses the prototype's fixed region, expanded so geometry keeps two air cells.

method.name: get_grid
method.description: Returns the probe grid (min, size, spacing, width, height, count).

method.name: get_iteration
method.description: Number of completed propagation passes.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns iteration, timing and local field counts.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns one production field as a texture in the prototype's atlas layout.

method.name: inject
method.description: Evaluates the prototype's first-bounce source term on the GPU.

method.name: read_environment_radiance
method.description: Reads an engine environment as the uniform environment radiance the solver consumes, using the engine's own ambient/sky panorama bake at [param size] and averaging it over the sphere. Returns zero when the environment disables its ambient source or has no readable sky.

method.name: read_field
method.description: Returns a CPU copy of one production field for parity checks.

method.name: read_links
method.description: Returns the 26-bit transport mask per probe.

method.name: refresh_display
method.description: Reads the current GPU fields back and refreshes the display textures.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears radiance and visibility and returns to iteration zero. The source term is kept.

method.name: sample_geometry
method.description: Samples the nearest active SDF primitive at a volume-local point. Returns signed [code]distance[/code], transformed [code]normal[/code], [code]albedo[/code] and [code]emission[/code], or an empty dictionary when no primitive is available.

method.name: set_boxes
method.description: Sets the analytic box list. Each entry is a dictionary with [code]min[/code], [code]max[/code] and [code]color[/code].

method.name: set_lights
method.description: Sets the light list used by the source term. Each entry is a dictionary with [code]type[/code] (prototype numbering: 0 omni, 1 directional, 2 spot), [code]enabled[/code], [code]casts_shadow[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]direction[/code] (the direction the light travels in), [code]color[/code] (linear), [code]intensity[/code] ([code]PI * light_energy * light_indirect_energy[/code] in Godot's non-physical light units), [code]range[/code], [code]attenuation[/code], [code]spot_angle_deg[/code] and [code]spot_attenuation[/code]. Directional, omni and spot lights follow the engine's own falloff, cone and shadow rules, so the source term matches the engine's direct light.

method.name: set_multi_bounce
method.description: Enables the prototype's multi-bounce term.

method.name: set_sh_visibility
method.description: Selects the SH triple-product visibility path (otherwise the binary mask path).

method.name: set_sky
method.description: Sets the uniform environment radiance outside the grid. Replaces the prototype's white sky scalar; the driver supplies the engine environment's radiance.

method.name: step
method.description: Runs propagation passes; one pass is exactly one full A/B exchange.
